references.text: Earlier in the same chapter, the people are instructed to follow the ark of the covenant carried by the Levitical priests.
The priests are commanded to take up the ark of the covenant and go before the people.
The priests carrying the ark of the covenant are told to stop at the edge of the Jordan River.
Describes the priests standing with the ark while the people hurry across the Jordan.
The priests carry the ark of the covenant before the people at Jericho, following the same pattern as during the crossing of the Jordan.
The ark of the covenant went before the people during their wilderness journey to find a resting place for them.
The description of the ark of the covenant (the ark) that the priests carried.
Moses delivered the law to the priests, the sons of Levi, who carried the Lord's ark of the covenant.
The Levites who carried the Lord's ark of the covenant received the book of the law, which was to be placed beside the ark.
The Epistle to the Hebrews mentions the ark of the covenant and its contents, linking Old Testament events with the new covenant.
